title: Health and news
can_do: Различать stop doing и stop to do, remember doing и remember to do.
Сказать, что предпочитаешь: I'd rather..., I prefer... to...
Строить догадки о настоящем и прошлом: she must be tired, he might have left.
Пересказать новость без источника: It is said that..., He is believed to...
Поговорить о выгорании и балансе работы и жизни.

points.title: Gerund or infinitive: stop, remember, try, forget
points.explain_ru: У некоторых глаголов смысл зависит от формы после них. stop doing: перестать делать; stop to do: остановиться, чтобы сделать. remember doing: помнить, что делал; remember to do: не забыть сделать. forget doing: забыть, что было; forget to do: забыть сделать. try doing: попробовать как способ; try to do: стараться, пытаться.

examples.en: I stopped checking email after 8 pm, and I sleep better.
examples.ru: Я перестал проверять почту после восьми вечера и сплю лучше.

examples.en: On the way home she stopped to buy some vitamins.
examples.ru: По дороге домой она остановилась, чтобы купить витамины.

examples.en: Remember to book a check-up before the end of the month.
examples.ru: Не забудь записаться на осмотр до конца месяца.

examples.en: I remember feeling completely burned out that winter.
examples.ru: Я помню, как той зимой чувствовал себя полностью выгоревшим.

examples.en: If you can't sleep, try turning off your phone an hour earlier.
examples.ru: Если не можешь уснуть, попробуй выключать телефон на час раньше.

ru_trap.wrong: I stopped to smoke last year.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "бросил курить" с инфинитивом. В английском stop to smoke значит "остановился, чтобы покурить". Перестать: stop + -ing.

points.title: would rather and prefer
points.explain_ru: Would rather + первая форма без to: I'd rather work from home. Отрицание: I'd rather not. Если хочешь, чтобы другой человек что-то сделал: would rather + он + прошедшее время: I'd rather you called me tomorrow. Prefer + -ing говорит о привычке, сравнение через to: I prefer walking to driving. Would prefer + to: I'd prefer to wait.

examples.en: I'd rather go for a walk than sit in another meeting.
examples.ru: Я лучше пойду прогуляться, чем буду сидеть еще на одной встрече.

examples.en: She'd rather not talk about her health at work.
examples.ru: Она предпочла бы не обсуждать здоровье на работе.

examples.en: I'd rather you didn't share this news yet.
examples.ru: Я бы предпочел, чтобы ты пока не делился этой новостью.

examples.en: He prefers running in the morning to running in the evening.
examples.ru: Он предпочитает бегать утром, а не вечером.

examples.en: We'd prefer to read the full report first.
examples.ru: Мы бы предпочли сначала прочитать полный отчет.

ru_trap.wrong: I would rather to stay at home tonight.
ru_trap.right: I would rather stay at home tonight.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "лучше останусь" подсказывает инфинитив с to. После would rather to не ставят, в отличие от would prefer to.

points.title: Deduction: must be, might be, can't be, must have done
points.explain_ru: Догадка по фактам. Почти уверен, что да: must be (сейчас), must have done (в прошлом). Почти уверен, что нет: can't be, can't have done. Возможно: might, may или could be, might have done. О прошлом всегда have + третья форма.

examples.en: She's been working twelve hours a day. She must be exhausted.
examples.ru: Она работает по двенадцать часов в день. Должно быть, вымотана.

examples.en: That can't be true. The study had only ten people.
examples.ru: Это не может быть правдой. В исследовании было всего десять человек.

examples.en: He might be ill. He hasn't answered since Monday.
examples.ru: Возможно, он заболел. Он не отвечает с понедельника.

examples.en: The story must have come from someone inside the company.
examples.ru: Эта история, должно быть, пришла от кого-то внутри компании.

examples.en: They can't have read the article properly.
examples.ru: Они не могли нормально прочитать статью.

ru_trap.wrong: He must forget about the meeting yesterday.
ru_trap.right: He must have forgotten about the meeting yesterday.
ru_trap.why_ru: Русское "он, наверное, забыл" стоит в прошедшем. В английском догадка о прошлом строится как must + have + третья форма; must forget значит "он обязан забыть".

points.title: Passive reporting: it is said that, he is believed to
points.explain_ru: В новостях часто не называют, кто именно говорит. Две схемы. It is said / believed / reported that + полное предложение: It is believed that the company will cut jobs. Или подлежащее + is said / believed + to + глагол: The company is believed to be in trouble. Если речь о прошлом: to have + третья форма: The CEO is said to have resigned.

examples.en: It is reported that the new law will start in March.
examples.ru: Сообщается, что новый закон вступит в силу в марте.

examples.en: The app is said to be the most popular in Europe.
examples.ru: Говорят, что это приложение самое популярное в Европе.

examples.en: It is believed that stress causes most sick days.
examples.ru: Считается, что стресс вызывает большую часть больничных.

examples.en: The founder is thought to have left the country.
examples.ru: Считается, что основатель уехал из страны.

examples.en: Thousands of users are known to have lost their data.
examples.ru: Известно, что тысячи пользователей потеряли данные.

ru_trap.wrong: The minister is said that he resigned.
ru_trap.right: The minister is said to have resigned.
ru_trap.why_ru: Русское "говорят, что он ушел" тянет за собой that после said. Выбери одну схему: It is said that he resigned или He is said to have resigned.

words.example: The headline was more dramatic than the article.
The breaking news interrupted the morning show.
Always check the source before you share a story.
There's a rumour that the company is for sale.
Every news site has some bias.
The launch got a lot of media coverage.
The company claims the app is completely safe.
Her post about burnout went viral overnight.
After the release week everyone was exhausted.
Poor sleep is a common symptom of stress.
It took him a month to recover after the project.
I have a check-up next Tuesday.
The last week before a launch is always stressful.
I'm trying to cut down on coffee.
The company now pays for mental health support.
Burnout is common in teams with constant deadlines.
We moved two tasks to reduce her workload.
He's on sick leave until Friday.
Remote work improved my work-life balance.
Regular overtime is a sign of bad planning.

items.prompt: I've stopped ___ coffee after lunch, and now I sleep much better.
Please remember ___ (send) me the report before you leave tonight.
I'll never forget to meet her for the first time at that conference.
answers: I'll never forget meeting her for the first time at that conference.
I will never forget meeting her for the first time at that conference.

items.prompt: I'm tired. I'd rather ___ at home today.
I'd rather you ___ (not / tell) anyone about this yet.
She would rather to work alone on this task.
answers: She would rather work alone on this task.
She'd rather work alone on this task.

items.prompt: He hasn't answered any messages since Monday. He ___ ill, but nobody knows for sure.
She's been answering emails since six in the morning. She ___ (be) exhausted.
He must forget about our call yesterday, because he didn't join.
answers: He must have forgotten about our call yesterday, because he didn't join.

items.prompt: The company is believed ___ thousands of users last year.
It ___ (say) that the CEO will step down next month.
Start with "The minister": It is reported that the minister has resigned.
answers: The minister is reported to have resigned.
